subject: general
question: Where do the Western and Eastern Ghats meet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nilgiri hills**__.

__
 
• **Nilgiri hills**- **The meeting point of the** **Eastern Ghats and the Western Ghats is the** **Nilgiri plateau**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Nilgiri hills are located in the** southern part of India.**
 
• These ranges are part of the **Western Ghats series**.
 
• Some parts of the **Nilgiri mountain range lie in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala as well.**
 
• The **highest peak is Doda Betta**** whose height is about 2637 meters**.
 
• Nilgiri is derived from the Tamil word in which Neelam means blue and Giri means mountain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cardamom hills**- Cardamom hills are in the state of Tamil Nadu.

 
 
• The **highest peak of the cardamom hills is Anai Mudi.**
 
• **These hills are adjacent to Kanyakumari.**
 
• It is widespread in th**e states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu**.
 
• These hills are famous for the production of good tea and cardamom.
 
 
 
• **Palani hill**s- **Palani hills is a range of mountains **that lie in the states of **Kerala and Tamil Nadu**.
 
 
• The hill is an eastward extension of the **Western Ghats, which aligns with the west coast of India**.
 
 
 
• **Annamalai hills-** The highest hill is Annamalai, which has a height (2,695 meters).
 
 
• **These hills are the joint place of the Eastern and Western Ghats** and are oriented towards the northwest and south-East.
 
• It is also called Elephant Mountains.
